asset.name: Sidebar
asset.description: The persistent navigation or workspace panel with sections, active state, collapse to icons, keyboard traversal, independent scrolling, and stable width.

requires.reason: Sizing, spacing, radius, and layer order resolve to declared ramps.
Background and elevation come from the shared surface primitive rather than per-overlay shadow values.
Independent scrolling with preserved keyboard behavior.
Items are shared navigation links with active and pending state.
All class composition uses the shared Tailwind conflict resolver.
